title: So ja sakina
body:
So ja sakina
PYARI SAKEENA PYASI SAKEENA, PYARI SAKEENA BALI SAKEENA *2
<<DIVIDER>>
SO JA SAKINA *4 PHIR NA MILEGA BABA KA SEENA
<<MINI>>
SOJA SAKEENA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
1- NA GHABRAO ZAKHMI BADAN KO NA DEKHO
SAKINA MERE PERAHAN KO NA DEKHO
YE BABA KA HAI IMTEHAA’N EY HAZEENA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
2- MERI ZINDAGI ME NA AANSU BAHAO
WAGARNA ME KEH DOONGA KHEME ME JAO
TUMHE MERE BIN AUR KUCHH DIN HAI JEENA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
3- TUJHE KIS TARHA SE DILAASE DOO’N BETI
MAI KUCHH DER KA AUR MEHMAA’N HOO’N BETI
HAI MAJHDHAAR ME MERA IS DAM SAFEENA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
4- MERE BAAD GUZRENGE FAQO’N PE FAQE’N
MERE BAAD KHANE HAIN TUJHKO TAMACHE
NA TU JA SAKEGI PALATKAR MADINA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
5- SAKINA BAHOT GHAM UTHANE HAIN TUJHKO
ABHI TAAZIYANE BHI KHANE HAIN TUJHKO
HAI MAATHE PE TERE YE KAISA PASEENA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
6- SAKINA MERE KHOON KI LAAJ RAKHNA
KISI SE KABHI KOI SHIKWA NA KARNA
HAR EK SAANS PAR KHOON KA GHOONT PEENA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
7-TUJHE AAJ KYUN NEEND AATI NAHI HAI
HAI KHAMOSH KYUN KUCHH BATATI NAHI HAI
TU ANGHUSHTARI KA HAI MERI NAGEENA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
8- MERA SAR DIKHAYEGA TUJHKO SITAMGAR
TERE SAR SE PHIR CHHEEN LEGA WO CHADAR
SATAYEGA REH REHKE TUJHKO KAMEENA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
<<DIVIDER>>
9- SADA DENGE ASIF AZADAR SUNKAR
NA PADH AUR AAMIR EY SHEH KE SUKHANWAR KE TADPENGE MARQAD ME SHAHE MADINA
<<MINI>>
SO JA SAKINA *4
PYARI SAKEENA PYASI SAKEENA, PYARI SAKEENA BALI SAKEENA *2
<<DIVIDER>>
